question: An aeroplane with a wingspan of $40$ m flies horizontally at $250$ m/s at a place where the vertical component of the Earth's magnetic field is $5 \times 10^{-5}$ T. The emf induced between its wing tips is
solution: The wings cut the vertical component of the field: $\varepsilon = B_Vvl = 5 \times 10^{-5} \times 250 \times 40 = 0.5$ V.
